Harper - Sales: Urgent: FinanceCo POC load run -> ~6% 502/503s for /v1/generate. Executive demo in 45m, blocked. Can infra triage?
Leo (infra): share a request id + timeframe + model.
Harper - Sales: req x-fc1234 window 14:07-14:11 UTC. model=rwd-large, client ~130rps with multi-turn prompts.
ScaleBot: autoscaler event: scale_up requested 14:06:50 UTC -> target gpupool-9 (pending).
Nadia (oncall): pulling logs. Can you ask them to replay one failing id with X-Request-ID for correlation?
Harper - Sales: replayed. Tail:```
[2026-08-03T14:08:03Z] x-fc1234 worker=gpupool-5 model=rwd-large error=502 upstream="kv-cache OOM"
[2026-08-03T14:08:03Z] throttled=true queue_len=1150 autoscale_pending=19s
```
Leo (infra): summary: KV cache pressure on rwd-large caused OOM -> worker dropped request -> 502. Autoscaler cold-start ~19s.
Harper - Sales: routing policy note: FinanceCo had `no-burst-fallback` flagged in SSO settings (from questionnaire). Is temporary exception possible?
Nadia (oncall): we can grant a 2-hour override to allow burstpool routing for the org. Applying now.
Nadia (oncall): override applied -> fallback allowed to gpupool-burst and compatible variant rwd-medium.
Harper - Sales: client reran 4 minutes later -> errors ~0.3%, demo cleared. Thanks!
Leo (infra): action items: 1) revert aggressive kv eviction for POCs on rwd-large; 2) add alert when queue_len>1000 and autoscale_pending>10s; 3) add a POC-runbook note to check routing flags from questionnaire.
Harper - Sales: customer asked about guaranteed demo capacity and cost. Quick ballpark?
Leo (infra): short-term reserved burst (hourly) ~ $60-120/hr depending on region; Dedicated commit for sustained needs. Will DM exact pricing to sales_eng.
Nadia (oncall): minimal log snippet for customer report:```
2026-08-03T14:08:03Z x-fc1234 error=502 "kv-cache OOM"; queue_len=1150; autoscale_pending=19s; fallback_blocked_by_policy
```
Harper - Sales: sending to FinanceCo. Will confirm if they want reserved burst. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
